title: Tumbling Tom Yellow - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Yellow Cherry Tomato Outdoor/Indoor
description:
A compact trailing cherry tomato variety, ideal for hanging baskets and small growing spaces. Produces heavy crops of sweet, bright yellow fruits. Supplied as a young plant, ready to grow on at home.


  Key Details:
 

   Harvesting Season:
  
  July to October
 

   Mature Size:
  
  Trails up to 30–50cm | Spread 40–60cm
 

   Position:
  
  Full sun | Prefers well-drained, fertile soil
 

   Ideal For:
  
  Hanging baskets, containers, window boxes
 

   Supplied As:
  
  Young plant in a grower’s pot
 

  Why Choose This Variety:
 

 ‘Tumbling Tom Yellow’ is perfect for patios, balconies, and other small spaces. Its cascading growth habit makes it especially suited to hanging displays, where it will produce an abundance of small, sweet tomatoes throughout summer. Easy to grow and highly productive, it’s suitable for both beginners and experienced gardeners.


  Growing Information:
 

   Planting Time:
  
  Plant out after the last frost (usually from May onwards)
 

   Where to Grow:
  
  Hanging baskets, containers, window boxes, greenhouse, or a sunny outdoor position
 

   Care Advice:
  
  Water regularly and feed weekly once flowering begins. No pruning or pinching required—allow stems to trail naturally for best results.
